tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Desktop behind every window: the orkspace's ground. Camp: the biome's soil, a quiet ground (docs/design/color-pass.md §2–3): forest is a dark neutral earth, away from the green buildings' hue, so they stand off it; ice and void from theme.py. The GUI wears each biome's ground from js/icons.js BIOMES; this is forest's. Office: Sublime's sidebar black.

tokens.name: terrain
tokens.usage: Terrain marks scattered on `canvas` (camp only; ≤12% of the surface). Decorative, never text. Forest: dry olive tufts a breath off the earth (js/terrain.js GLYPHS). Office has no terrain: equals `canvas`.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Window and building interior, menus, cards. The main ground for `ink`, `ink-muted` and every signal text.

tokens.name: panel-inset
tokens.usage: Sunken wells inside a panel: inputs, logs, terminals, the War Map list. Camp: a dark recess under `bevel-sunken`; Office: the editor gutter tone.

tokens.name: panel-raised
tokens.usage: Raised faces: buttons, tabs, title bars, the HUD strip. Text on it is `ink` or `ink-gold` only.

tokens.name: banner
tokens.usage: Camp's cloth: the active window's title bar and the active tab, dark maroon (the round-2 banners' red #a32926 darkened, docs/design/town-readability.md §2), so it is never read as an error's red. A fill under `ink` (9.8:1) or `ink-gold` (7.5:1). Ice: its raised face. Office: its raised face, and office.css draws no banner.

tokens.name: bevel-hi
tokens.usage: Lit edge of a camp bevel (top/left); in Office a 1px hairline. Used only inside the `bevel-*` shadows.

tokens.name: bevel-lo
tokens.usage: Shadowed edge of a camp bevel (bottom/right) and the 2px outer keyline of camp windows.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selected row in lists, the War Map and menus. Text on it is `ink` only.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: Inactive window and building frame. Forest: warm wood, ≥3:1 on `panel` (3.9) and on the forest ground (4.5), so a frame reads as a frame (it was bronze gold #a07c38, the colour pass moved Camp's chrome off gold, docs/design/open-questions.md Q18); ice and void keep theme.py `border`; Office: a warm brown hairline, below 3:1 on purpose, never the only cue.

tokens.name: hut-frame
tokens.usage: The frame of a hut on the town map. Camp: frame (warm wood). Office: ≈3:1 on canvas, so a block keeps its box in a diagram (frame alone is a decorative hairline).

tokens.name: frame-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, checkboxes, unfocused buttons in Office. ≥3:1 on `panel`.

tokens.name: frame-focus
tokens.usage: Focused window frame, the selection of a building and the focus ring of every control. Camp (forest and void): bleached bone, a step above the wood `frame` and never a signal's yellow (it was gold #e8b94a, Q18); ≥3:1 on every ground (10.6 on `panel`). Ice: #82aaff. Office: the gold office.css mutes. ≥3:1 on all grounds.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and building names (hut.py HEAD_STYLE, parchment in Camp; a warm parchment white in Office). On every ground.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Live status lines, secondary labels, hints (hut.py LIVE_STYLE). On `panel`, `panel-inset`, `canvas`.

tokens.name: ink-comment
tokens.usage: Disabled text, placeholder decoration, terrain-level hints (a warm grey in Office). Below 4.5:1 by design: never for content someone must read.

tokens.name: ink-gold
tokens.usage: Camp's voice: button labels, building actions, window titles, HUD numbers (hut.py BUTTON_STYLE). The name is kept so nothing breaks; Camp's value is light birch wood, no longer gold (Q18): 8.9:1 on `panel`, 6.4:1 on `panel-raised`, 7.5:1 on `banner`. Office: its own accent (office.css makes it the ink).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of the one primary button in a dialog (Draft, Build, Send). Camp: Factorio-style confirm green; Office: the same moss green, a little brighter.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on `action`.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: A question waiting — the first fire stage (hut.py FIRE[0]): the question's yellow, the same as `signal-ask` in every theme, so a question is yellow everywhere (docs/design/design-system-v2.md §12, answer 2). Red is `alert-hot` / `signal-fire` (an error, 🔥), ⏳ is `signal-held`. Text on `panel`/`canvas`; frames and badges anywhere.

tokens.name: alert-hot
tokens.usage: Left waiting past 30 s — the red stage (FIRE[1]); Office: the red frame of a waiting building. Fills, frames and icons only (≥3:1), not body text.

tokens.name: fire-glow
tokens.usage: Flicker partner of `alert` (FIRE[2]), a warm light yellow. Camp animation only.

tokens.name: fire-ember
tokens.usage: Flicker partner of `alert-hot` (FIRE[3]). Camp animation only.

tokens.name: fire-ground
tokens.usage: Ground under a building in the orange stage (FIRE_GROUND[0]). `ink` reads on it.

tokens.name: fire-ground-hot
tokens.usage: Ground under a building in the red stage (FIRE_GROUND[1]). `ink` reads on it.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Passed checks, ✓ rows, diff additions (theme.py DIFF_ADD). Always paired with ✓ or a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failures, ✗ rows, diff removals, destructive buttons (DIFF_REMOVE). Always paired with ✗ or a word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Held carts, ⚠ notes (carts.py held).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Links, info marks, the ice biome's accent.

tokens.name: unit-active
tokens.usage: An ork at work (theme.py UNIT_ACTIVE). Camp: light wood, work is not a signal (it was gold #e5c07b).

tokens.name: unit-alert
tokens.usage: An ork in trouble (theme.py UNIT_ALERT).

tokens.name: harness-claude

tokens.name: harness-agy

tokens.name: harness-codex

tokens.name: harness-cursor

tokens.name: harness-pipeline

tokens.name: day

tokens.name: road

tokens.name: road-bright

tokens.name: road-selected

tokens.name: road-live

tokens.name: tier-elder

tokens.name: sticky-red

motion.note: Durations and curves (docs/design/design-system-v2.md §10). Under prefers-reduced-motion frames stop on their first, the cover lift is instant and the launch is its line only; every animation pauses while the window is hidden.

tokens.name: motion-frame
tokens.usage: One frame of work as motion: sprite frames at 8 fps (an ork's tool, cart wheels, a building's turning part, the catapult). Idle shows none.

tokens.name: motion-frame-phone
tokens.usage: One frame on the phone: at most 12 fps, stopped while the page is hidden.

tokens.name: motion-cover
tokens.usage: The cover lifting: opacity to 0 as the zoom crosses into close, with `motion-ease-out`; the walls and crest never fade. Instant under reduced motion.

tokens.name: motion-peek
tokens.usage: A hover or select turning the cover half-clear (to 50 %).

tokens.name: motion-zoom
tokens.usage: The zoom easing between ladder steps; it rests only on a step.

tokens.name: motion-flicker
tokens.usage: One cycle of a `!` or a stuck cart's flicker: 2 Hz, two steps. 🔥 flickers with fire-glow / fire-ember.

tokens.name: motion-ask
tokens.usage: A ❓ appearing: a 2-frame bob (two `motion-frame`s), then still.

tokens.name: motion-launch
tokens.usage: The catapult's 4 launch frames.

tokens.name: motion-launch-arc
tokens.usage: The load's arc over the wall, after the launch frames.

tokens.name: motion-launch-line
tokens.usage: How long the launch's one chip line ("PR #42 opened") stays. No sound, no confetti, never in quiet hours.

tokens.name: motion-cart-speed
tokens.usage: A cart's speed on the track at the overview zoom, per second, stepped to whole art pixels; it waits at a switch, never overtakes.

tokens.name: motion-ease-out
tokens.usage: The curve of the cover lifting and of anything arriving.

tokens.name: motion-ease
tokens.usage: The curve of the zoom between steps.

meta.note: Camp keeps the TUI's hex values where they exist; its chrome is warm wood, bone and maroon cloth (the colour pass, docs/design/color-pass.md §3, moved it off gold: docs/design/open-questions.md Q18), and bright yellow and red are kept for signals. Office keeps VS Code's layout, calm and monochrome (office.css). Sprite sizes and the ground are new for the GUI.
